Triage (R+90, triage seat, session `session_019kDRpB7D2XzVzkaLp57T5D`): **`pm:queue`** · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · `documentation` · type **Task**. `finding` removed.

**Lands in:** `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` — one docs-only PR, the shape the card prescribes: §6.2 becomes the cluster-invalidation **family** (shared contract: address-only signal, receipt = convergence from the replica's own read, `originNode` loopback suppression, at-most-once bounded by boot rehydration), keeps the `metadata.changed` description, adds the two convergence lanes with their channel constants and payload types named, and fixes the bridge plugin's `See cluster.mdx §5` pointer to §6. ⛔ Documenting one lane alone is refused — a page describing two of three is the same defect one member smaller.

**Premise check binding on the dev:** lane 3 (`datasource.mutated`, #13805) was in flight when this was filed. Re-read both lanes on the merged tree and document what is there; if #13805 has not landed, document lane 2 and the family, and say in the PR body that lane 3 follows — ⛔ do not describe an unlanded channel as shipped.

Size/model suggestion: S, `sonnet`/`opus`.

- **File surface:** `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` (§6.2 → the cluster-invalidation family, §7.3 cross-reference) and `packages/services/service-cluster/src/metadata-cluster-bridge-plugin.ts` ONE docblock line (`See content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx §5` → §6; comment text only, no code). No changeset for the docs; if the one-line docblock edit in a published package needs one per the repo's changeset gate the dev adds a `@objectstack/service-cluster: patch` changeset and says so. ⛔ No other file; ⛔ `content/docs/releases/**` untouched.
- **Premise re-verified on `origin/main` `a98b61b3e`:** both convergence lanes are landed — `METADATA_MUTATION_CLUSTER_CHANNEL = 'metadata.mutated'` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:4010`, #13331 closed) and `DATASOURCE_MUTATION_CLUSTER_CHANNEL = 'datasource.mutated'` (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts:71`, #13805 closed); the bridge plugin binds Lane 1/2/3 (`:117`, `:191`, `:245`) and still points at "§5" (`:58`); `content/docs` reads zero hits for `metadata.mutated` / `datasource.mutated`, and `cluster.mdx` §6.2 (`:325`) names `metadata.changed` only. So the triage's "if #13805 has not landed" branch does not apply — all three lanes are documented as shipped.
- **Container & model:** subagent lane (S), sonnet — the triage's suggestion.
- **Clause ②:** not reached — documentation of existing, landed channels; no contract change.
- **Serial constraints:** none in this seat's flight touch `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx` or the bridge plugin; #14208 (+#14289) holds `scripts/pm/**`, #14386/#14173 hold `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` and `packages/lint`, #13798 batch 1 (cloud) holds its own lint test files.
